# Warudo triggers

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to Warudo.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%warudo.host%` | The computer Warudo runs on |
| `%warudo.port%` | The port number it uses |

<small>Type id: `warudo.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when the connection to Warudo drops, for example because you closed it.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%warudo.host%` | The computer Warudo runs on |
| `%warudo.port%` | The port number it uses |
| `%reason%` | Why it dropped |

<small>Type id: `warudo.disconnected`</small>

## Toggle changed

Runs when an "On Stream Deck Toggle" node in Warudo turns on or off, whoever flipped it (Cuebot, a Stream Deck or Warudo itself).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Receiver names** | Only react to these Receiver Names. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any. |
| **Turned** | Only react when it turns On, only when it turns Off, or Any. Options: Any, On, Off. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%warudo.host%` | The computer Warudo runs on |
| `%warudo.port%` | The port number it uses |
| `%receiver%` | The Receiver Name of the toggle |
| `%state%` | On or Off |
| `%value%` | True when it is now on |

<small>Type id: `warudo.toggleChanged`</small>
